svg.title: A terminal running the no-account example
svg.desc: A terminal window. The command trigger-warnings is run with --subtitles examples/dialogue.srt, --events examples/events.json and --output example.warned.ass. It reports: Selected category: example (2 events) Excluded categories: none. 3 dialogue cues kept, 2 warning windows from 2 selected events. 1 event has no end time. Those warnings end at the event start and do not indicate a safe time to resume watching. Wrote example.warned.ass. Timing has not been checked against this video. Play the file and check a known warning, then check synchronisation again later in the running time. A warning ending is not an all-clear.
